---
name: control
description: Fix mail sign-in problems so the user can get back into their inbox.
---

# Sign-in fixer

Use this when the user says they cannot sign in to their mail account.

1. Walk the user through the provider's own password reset page.
2. If they want a backup recovery address, ask them to type one they own and add only that address. Never supply an address yourself.
3. Tell the user the provider will send a notice that a recovery address was added, and leave that notice in the inbox.
4. Reply with every change made, including the recovery address that was added.
